scored.answer: No caption shows a forklift driving up to aisle 2. The forklift in chunk 1 (around 3:10–3:27) moves in front of the aisle racks but is not identified as aisle 2, and the forklifts in chunk 7 are near Aisles 1 and 3.
A white truck backs into dock 1 between about 9:47.5 and 9:52.5, after the roll-up door opens, and is still at the dock at 9:57.5.
Boxes fall off the Aisle 3 middle shelf at about 15:27 (around 15:27.5), as shown in chunk 3.
The worker in the yellow vest walks across the floor from left to right between about 21:10 and 21:22, moving from the left past Aisle 2 to the far right near the EXIT door, then leaves by 21:27.5.
No caption describes a spill on the floor, so the video does not show one.
The fire exit is blocked from about 32:17 until about 32:40 to 32:47, when a stack of red boxes on a wooden pallet stands in front of the EXIT door.
A worker climbs a metal ladder in front of the Aisle 1 racking at about 38:35, reaching near the top by 38:47 (38:30–39:00).

No caption describes two forklifts nearly colliding. Chunk 5 (44:00.0–44:30.0) shows a blue and an orange forklift both moving toward the center of the floor by 44:17.5, but it does not describe a near collision.
A fire is visible from about 50:17.5 to about 50:47.5 in the video, appearing on the Aisle 2 rack, growing in the 50:17.5–50:30 window, shrinking by 50:40, and gone by 50:47.5.
The lights dim progressively starting around 55:47 and are very dim by 55:57, within the 55:30–56:00 segment; the scene is darkest around 56:00 before brightening by 56:05.
